Results were merged and deduplicated with the detector's own algorithm (key: where|claim[:60]). 26 unique discrepancies across 10 items, all brief<->surface drift in the development record; zero findings against the shipped binary's behaviour or the user-facing docs. Maintainer disposition per the iss-152 (v0.4.1) precedent: residue captured as iss-192, release not blocked.
